auth.loginSubtitle: Accanto is here to help you keep track.
auth.registerSubtitle: Just a few details. Everything stays yours, on your servers or those of your Accanto host.

account.title: Your account
account.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two new passwords don't match.
account.languageSectionHint: The app will use this language on your devices.
account.deleteDescription: Deletion permanently removes your profile and any circles where you are the only member, along with the related journal, documents, questions and updates. If you share a circle with other people, you must first have them leave or leave the circle yourself.
account.deleteUnderstand: I understand this action is irreversible.
account.exportHint: Download a ZIP archive with your profile, journal entries, uploaded documents, questions, updates, audit log and preferences.
account.sessionsHint: Devices and browsers signed in to your account. Revoke any you don't recognise.
